initialization: from scratch; no old checkpoint or resume
final_balanced_selector: not claimed in pilot; retain metric-specific best and Pareto candidates
best_pt_alias: validation chain-macro AP for backward compatibility, not final balanced selection
thresholds: literal 0.5 and validation shared-gate diagnostic sweeps 0.01:0.99; no per-chain oracle
calibration: none fitted during pilot; component-grouped calibration/cross-fitting is separate future work
test_policy: Do not select or evaluate pilot variants on test; existing 724 test is already inspected, not sealed
E_weight_interpretation: initial loss-form pilot, not matched-gradient or matched-scale claim
schedule: 8e-5; 10% linear warmup from 0.02 scale, then constant; no cosine decay
reported_epoch_loss: valid-chain-weighted; legacy batch mean separately retained
